en: Puggalapaññatti Niddesa 8. Exposition of the Eight Types of Persons (Aṭṭhakapuggalapaññatti)
In this regard, who are the four individuals possessing the paths and the four individuals possessing the fruits? They are:
the stream-enterer and the one practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry;
the once-returner and the one practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning.
The non-returner, one practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning;
the arahant, one practicing for the realization of the fruit of arahantship—
these are the four individuals who possess the paths and these four individuals who possess the fruits.
